note: Static upload (Vercel): there is no game server on this origin. /api/health, /api/rooms and /api/characters are answered from these files, and the match itself is run by the page -- public/engine/*.py under Pyodide, driven by public/js/local.js. Multiplayer needs no server either: whoever creates a room runs that match in their own browser, extra tabs of one browser talk over a BroadcastChannel while other computers connect straight to the host over a WebRTC data channel (public/js/p2p.js) with the handshake carried as two copied codes -- so any number of rooms can run at once, each with its own map.
